"New Features {added marginTop} ======================
* **Introducing text chat…*but in voice channels.*** Voice channels now have embedded chat that's specific to each voice channel. Peep general, is a thing of the past. * **But how exactly do they work?** How's this different from regular text channels? They pop out, they're unique to a voice channel, and if you wanna learn more, [I gotchu.](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/4412085582359)
Fixes and Updates {progress} ======================
* **Added li'l flags to language selection.** It's not that important…but it's cute. :) * **Are you sure you want to log out?** alert added for when you log out. And you're sure of it. If you're unsure, flip a coin. * **In-app notifications now show images.** Nice. * **Added 6 countries to our billing forms.** If you're from: Ascension (AC), Diego Garcia (DG), East Timor (TP), Kosovo (XK), Midway Island (MI), or Netherland Antilles (AN), you can now properly input your addresses.
